title: Establish public repository governance and project board
acceptance: Public repository contains game-source and asset directories, design documents and the development process.
Project board links scoped issues with priorities and release gates.
Markdown and link checks pass on GitHub; main enforces PR and status checks.
Rights notice and contribution policy match the project ownership terms.

title: Decide multiplayer battle format
acceptance: Compare sequential turns and simultaneous planning for small and large parties.
Describe idle handling, coordination and transitions between exploration and encounters.
Record the selected format and its consequences in the design documents.

title: Define customization scope and art pipeline
acceptance: Define initial customization dimensions and compatible outfit/body combinations.
Specify original character shapes, expressions, animation and readability targets.
Evaluate camera and animation production methods before asset production.

title: Define daytime behavior-to-power rules
acceptance: Define discovery, duration, stacking and reset behavior for daytime effects.
Provide three draft powers with tactical choices and comic consequences.
Separate illustrative move ideas from accepted balance values.

title: Outline the first connected story episode
acceptance: Connect a daytime choice, sunset complication, battle and next-day consequence.
Place narration and alternate outcomes around player choices.
Settle the episode scope and identify any unresolved setting details.

title: Decide engine, camera and multiplayer architecture
acceptance: Evaluate engines against battle pacing, art pipeline and development capacity.
Define authoritative state, campaign ownership and interruption behavior.
Record the selected architecture and two-client validation plan.

title: Define aging, memory loss and generation boundaries
acceptance: Describe aging triggers, mixed-age parties and the effects of forgetting.
Separate narrative memory loss from player collection persistence.
Decide which generational content belongs in the first game.

title: Set vertical-slice scope and playtest evidence targets
acceptance: Scope a complete session after the battle, art and architecture decisions.
Define external playtest acceptance targets.
Specify build, save/load and reconnect evidence needed for G2.
